crossRefs.note: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”

parallels.note: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be.…

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
translations.bsb: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”
translations.kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
translations.asv: And the rest said, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to save him.
